geometry: ul.flex w-full flex-wrap justify-center gap-[3em]; cards 42em; 2 columns at 1280, 1 below 768; rows stretch

responsive.note: Row pitch varies because align-items is stretch and card heights are content-driven.

motion.RULE: ZERO animation. No whileInView, no stagger, no per-card delay. Static from first paint.

states: No hover, no active, no focus, no transition, no box-shadow.
